seeded_checks: hand-computed distinct counts, medians and top-five lists; thin/neutral/mixed methods; source-year windows

real_feed_result.window_precision: source-year intervals overlap the requested calendar window; not exact award/publication dates
real_feed_result.grouping_method: normalized opportunity-title groups; not scientific taxonomy
real_feed_result.notice: Research counts are distinct source identifiers within overlapping fiscal/calendar-year intervals, not exact award or publication dates. Scores remain their original versioned portfolio proxies; they are not recalculated for the requested window. Neutral 50 placeholders are excluded from medians and rankings. A thin sample cannot establish a confident funding gap. Mixed or missing methodologies suppress comparative scores and rankings. Opportunity-title groups are not a scientific taxonomy. High gap proxies are not proof of neglect or underfunding; broad FOA and award-core publication associations do not prove current-opportunity funding or topic relevance.
